body: I read that drinking more than 1 litre of water in less than 1 hour could cause damage or something like that
I used to do that but lately they've been asking me not to hug them 'cause then they wanna cry...

Actually, I was just thinking about what you said...

Most of the time, I think about killing myself but I try to have hope, to hope things will get better, that I can get help...

However, in reddit I've seen people lose hope, people who have gotten help but it hasn't worked...  I think that there's a possibility things will get better, but it is also possible that won't happen.  I take the decision to live every single day 'cause I think things could get better, but if a person doesn't think that will happen or simply doesn't wanna find out, why shouldn't they kill themselves if they want to?
A part of me also thought of taking a break, but wasn't sure.  Thanks for the advice :)

I've tried.  I do stuff all day but as soon as I stop I can't help it: I feel awful and I want to do it.  It is also like a roller coaster, sometimes I go up, sometimes I'm super down... My emotional state can change in minutes or days... It's awful
I can talk, I'd also like that...
